Edge AI - Raspberry Pi 5

Pi Person Detection Pipeline

The system running at home: frame differencing on a Pi 5 camera feed spots motion first, then YOLOv8n via ONNX Runtime confirms a person before a photo snapshot is saved and an alert goes out. Cheap check first, neural net second, so the Pi is not running inference on empty rooms.

Home network project - Raspberry Pi

Pi-hole DNS Ad Blocker

A Raspberry Pi running Pi-hole as the network DNS server, so ads and trackers get blocked at the DNS level for every device on the network at once, before the request ever leaves the house. Devices point at the Pi for DNS, known ad and tracking domains resolve to nothing, everything else forwards upstream. The demo below simulates its query log live.

Raspberry PiDNSDHCPLinuxBlocklists

Cyber demo - Pi-hole

Pi-hole query log: simulated live feed

What the Pi-hole admin log looks like on a real home network. Queries stream in from devices, known ad and tracker domains get blocked at DNS, the rest forward upstream. Simulated locally, using the kinds of domains a real log shows.

Cyber demo - Firewall

Firewall rule simulator

Write rules the way a real firewall reads them: top to bottom, first match wins, default policy catches the rest. Add or remove rules, then fire test packets at your own ruleset.

Add a rule

Test a packet

Packet result will appear here.

Try it: the preloaded ruleset blocks one bad IP outright, opens web ports, and denies everything else by default. Test the same IP on port 443, then a normal IP on port 22.
